summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US equivalent of an 8-K) attaching a press release dated October 7, 2026, announcing a routine capital increase from RSU exercises under its incentive program. Share capital rose by 61,105 Class A shares, a nominal USD 611.05 increase: 57,772 shares at DKK 179.80 and 3,333 at DKK 124.20. Post-issuance capital is USD 1,027,118.82 across 102,711,882 A-shares. No pre-emption rights applied; listing on Nasdaq Copenhagen is expected. No special-situation angle; watch only minor dilution and registration-statement incorporation by reference.
